title: 引导
summary: 教学不是弹窗，也不是一条提示。先定何时出现、钉在谁身上、靠什么推进、结束后还挡不挡。
summaryEn: Teaching is not a dialog, and not a notice. First decide when it appears, what it pins to, how the user advances, and whether it still blocks after.
asks: 引导何时出现、钉在谁身上、靠什么推进、结束后还挡不挡？
asksEn: When does teaching appear, what does it pin to, how does the user advance, and does it still block after?

links.when: 教学打断不是任务弹窗
links.whenEn: a teaching interrupt is not a task dialog

links.when: 教怎么用不是报已经发生的事
links.whenEn: teaching how to use it is not reporting something that already happened

links.whenEn: a cutout scrim is not an inverted card notch
